story.title: A New Find
paragraphs_en: "Playing all the time, Raghu! Read the newspapers and learn something new about the world." said Appa. "What is so new in Newspapers, Appa?"asked Raghu Do you know astronomers from NASA - the American Space Agency have discovered seven new exoplanets revolving around another star called TRAPPIST - 1?"

"EXOPLANETS??? Never heard of them, Appa." exclaimed Raghu. "Exoplanet is a planet that orbits (revolves around) another star outside our solar system." explained Appa. "Really Appa! So will there be another earth?" asked Raghu. "The news says three out of the seven planets may have water. So may be there is another earth somewhere else too." said Appa.

"Another earth..." wondered Raghu. "How interesting will it be to travel to another earth?" That night as he lay on his bed he wondered if he could travel to space into another solar system. "I will grow up and become an astronaut." he said to himself.

"The first astronaut to travel - not to the Moon, not to Mars but to a different solar system altogether." he mumbled in his sleep. There were two things that Raghu often dreamt of - Straight Hair and Space Travel That day he dreamt of both together.

"10, 9, 8, 7 .... 3, 2, 1, Zeeero! Mission to find another Earth - Go" "Astronaut Raghu flying high to the TRAPPIST - 1 Solar System." Astronaut Raghu reporting to Earth, "I have been attacked by Space Bugs." Earth to Astronaut Raghu, "Use the ultra-sonic bug catcher." Swish ... Swoosh ... Dump! Astronaut Raghu reporting to Earth, "All the Space Bugs caught. Mission Accomplished!"

In his dream, Raghu manoeuvred his ship further ahead crossing all the planets of our Solar System. "There goes gaseous Jupiter." "Wow, the Rings of Saturn are amazing." "Oh, the dwarf planet - Pluto." Astronaut Raghu to Earth,"I am out of our Solar System."

Astronaut Raghu had just sighted the ultra cool dwarf star TRAPPIST - 1 when he heard someone call his name. Amma was trying to wake Raghu. "Wake-up Raghu. It is time to go to school." said Amma, caressing his forehead.

"Good Morning Amma! Did you hear about NASA's new find?" asked the very excited Raghu. "Oh yes, Astronaut Raghu!" exclaimed Amma. Raghu looked at her in surprise and asked, "How Amma?" "You mumbled it all in your sleep, Astronaut Raghu." said Amma with a laugh.
